mapper.sql: r.review_id, r.user_id, r.book_id, r.order_id, r.rating, r.content, r.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, b.book_name, b.cover_image AS book_cover, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '⭐' WHEN 2 THEN '⭐⭐' WHEN 3 THEN '⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 4 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 5 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' END AS rating_stars, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '很差' WHEN 2 THEN '较差' WHEN 3 THEN '一般' WHEN 4 THEN '满意' WHEN 5 THEN '非常满意' END AS rating_desc FROM tb_review r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_book b ON r.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT , u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, b.book_name, b.cover_image AS book_cover, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '⭐' WHEN 2 THEN '⭐⭐' WHEN 3 THEN '⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 4 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 5 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' END AS rating_stars, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '很差' WHEN 2 THEN '较差' WHEN 3 THEN '一般' WHEN 4 THEN '满意' WHEN 5 THEN '非常满意' END AS rating_desc FROM tb_review r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_book b ON r.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT , u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, b.book_name, b.cover_image AS book_cover, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '⭐' WHEN 2 THEN '⭐⭐' WHEN 3 THEN '⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 4 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐' WHEN 5 THEN '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐' END AS rating_stars, CASE r.rating WHEN 1 THEN '很差' WHEN 2 THEN '较差' WHEN 3 THEN '一般' WHEN 4 THEN '满意' WHEN 5 THEN '非常满意' END AS rating_desc FROM tb_review r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_book b ON r.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId}
